failures: ordinary string ending in a backslash was reported as MIGRATION_SQL_UNTERMINATED
dollar literals and nested comments were rejected by mutation admission
prior readback was generated before the ledger-state branch and catalog validation preceded the lock

threads.title: Match the freeze verifier to the minimized test suite
threads.evidence: The historical runner expected 19 tests while the retained minimization amendment declared 18. The historical runner and bound artifact map remain byte-unchanged; the new source-bound verifier expects the current 23 tests and 141 assertions.

threads.title: Honor standard-conforming backslashes in SQL strings
threads.evidence: The shared lexical pass treats backslashes as escapes only for E-prefixed strings. Ordinary strings follow standard_conforming_strings=on and the original bytes remain unchanged.

threads.title: Run readbacks only in the database state where they are valid
threads.evidence: The atomic block checks ledger presence before either dynamic readback. Reconciliation uses psql gset/if branching so the server never parses the inactive query. Isolated PG17 passed missing-terminal preimage and missing-prior existing-ledger cases.

threads.title: Keep generic-error reconciliation fail-closed
threads.evidence: Only post-success readback validation errors may be confirmed. A generic transport failure performs one read-only reconciliation without resend and returns MIGRATION_OUTCOME_UNCONFIRMED even when the table and ledger exist.

threads.title: Mask all admitted SQL literals and nested comments
threads.evidence: Readback mutation admission now consumes the same lexical pass used for statement boundaries, including dollar bodies and nested block comments.

threads.title: Tokenize comments inside multiword transaction controls
threads.evidence: Control detection now reads unmasked SQL words, so PREPARE or START separated from TRANSACTION by comments remains denied.

threads.title: Resolve verifier tools from the active environment
threads.evidence: The new verifier resolves Bun, Python, and Git from explicit TZUDONG_* overrides or PATH and passed with Node 24.19.0, Bun 1.4.0, and Python 3.14.8. The historical artifact-bound runner remains unchanged.

threads.title: Lock the ledger before validating its schema
threads.evidence: Only existence and bounded privilege admission precede LOCK TABLE. All pg_attribute, pg_class, and pg_constraint contract validation now runs after the EXCLUSIVE lock.

threads.title: Require a privilege that permits the exclusive ledger lock
threads.evidence: Admission requires SELECT, INSERT, and one of UPDATE, DELETE, or TRUNCATE before requesting EXCLUSIVE. An actual PG17 SELECT+INSERT role returned MIGRATION_LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE without source or ledger writes.

limits: Historical PG15.8 and PG17.6 runtime receipts remain bound to their old source hashes and are not current verification.
The root-owned bundle module and bundle tests are outside this disposition and were not used as evidence.
No hosted, production, deployment, or operating database claim is made.
